notes.title: My new game "Comet Rogue" is out now!
notes.content:
I just launched my new game: Comet Rogue! It's a fast-paced mining roguelike where you extract gold from asteroids while freaky aliens are trying to kill you. It only costs $5, so go check it out!

Store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3252310/Comet_Rogue/

notes.title: Coliseum Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! [b]Today, the coliseum update launches![/b] The new coliseum game mode features you being trapped in a box and forced to collect wands. (when you put it that way, it doesn't sound too fun, but trust me...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/63837ff83fd1536437b971f16d9ca85e340c5e23.png[/img]

There's also a new shop that works a bit differently, and contains a couple more items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/9287db78d7cd0f95596f9f2aa99378164e2d45ef.png[/img]

You can also find all of the classic items too:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/c63b6aad3934dc0edbf8441bc59491e7c56c3e74.png[/img]

There are new buffed enemies in coliseum mode: (the screenshot doesn't really do the particle effect justice tho)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/04df0b6d4f0053d28e7b0548058cbfd393a15911.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

By popular demand, the enemies now have a chance to drop health potions! This is an attempt to make the game less punishing while keeping most of the difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/bab9a28ba02ec419bc287da08bef30d7a31d11b2.png[/img]


Also, this is pretty minor, but defeating the boss in the normal game now refills your mana, making the game right after a boss fight a little less annoying.


I hope you enjoy this update! Please let me know what you think.

-Vincent


(artist rendering of me working on the game:)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/eff9ff5f3633f125844db74d01754c41eb5b234a.png[/img]

notes.title: February demo update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've just updated the demo today. Here's what I added:
(note that there is more content in the full game, which will release soon!)

Added compatibility mode for slow computers.
(disclaimer: compatibility mode doesn't actually look like this)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/b3cf6ff47ab1481ce7804c5b658f3854e3f80e16.png[/img]


Added a jump height upgrade!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786295/3fc23067593f3e359209b879b235a7182f745926.png[/img]


Added a couple more wands to find! (there's more in the full version!)

Added an annoying rat that pesters you until you buy the full game. (buying the full game kills him :D)

Thanks for reading, and stay tuned for a big announcement!
